title: 1.3 The Alarm Spreads
concept: Bottom-up subtree height in postorder (leaf = 1) and tree diameter
objective: Enter the height of each room in Postorder (leaves first), then enter the tree's total Diameter!
controls: Use [-]/[+]/1-9 and [Enter] (or Submit button) to enter the highlighted room's height, then Diameter
start_status: Postorder height check: enter the height of the highlighted leaf room (leaf = 1) and press Submit [Enter]!
hints: Under the course convention, an empty child has height 0, a leaf has height 1, and a parent's height is 1 + max(leftHeight, rightHeight).
The longest path (diameter, in nodes) through a root is leftHeight + rightHeight + 1 using the heights of its two subtrees.
